description: This file defines the PrepareBodyMiddleware class, which is responsible for preparing HTTP request objects by adding appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. It is part of GuzzleHttp, a PHP HTTP client library, and handles middleware logic related to request bodies.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for preparing HTTP request bodies by setting headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that receives the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes the request to add necessary headers before passing it to the next handler.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Helper method to add the Expect header based on request and options.
